task_description: Add SSL/TLS between agent and server. Same behaviour than real puppet is expected (client auth, CA shared between agent and server, PKI on server side). On server side, a feature needs to be added to sign client certificate, and as real puppet, a custom config could allow auto signing. Docker images needs to be updated, as well as debian packages if needed, and multipass/Vagrant setup - Please note that OpenSSL is already a dependance, so do not use gnutls"
